module mux4to1 (
    input [3:0] in,
    input [1:0] sel,
    output out
);

and u1 (output, in[3], sel[0], in[0]); // 1st AND gate
or u2 (output, in[0], in[1]); // 2nd OR gate
and u3 (output, in[2], sel[0], in[1]); // 3rd AND gate
nand u4 (output, sel[0], sel[1]); // 4th NAND gate
not u5 (output, in[0]); // 5th NOT gate
or u6 (output, in[0]); // 6th OR gate
nand u7 (output, in[3], sel[0], in[2]); // 7th NAND gate
nor u8 (output, sel[0], sel[1]); // 8th NOR gate
and u9 (output, in[3], sel[0], in[2]); // 9th AND gate
or u10 (output, in[0]); // 10th OR gate
nand u11 (output, sel[0], sel[1]); // 11th NAND gate

endmodule

module piso_8bit(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input load,
    input [7:0] pin,
    output sout
);

    wire [7:0] q; // Outputs from the register stack.

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
        if (!rst) begin
            q <= 8'd0; // Reset the entire stack to 0.
        end
    end

    assign sout = q[7]; // The most significant bit (MSB) is the serial output.
    
    // Feedback loop: The MSB (sout) is shifted back into the LSB.
    assign q[0] = load ? pin : q[7];

endmodule

  input w,
  input R,
  input E,
  input L,

    end else if (C) begin
      Q <= S;
    end else begin
      Q <= R; // Invalid D input
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input j,
  input k,
  output reg Q
);

always @ (posedge clk) begin
  if (j && !k) begin
    Q <= 0; // if j=1 and k=0, Q is reset to 0
  end else {
    case (k)
      1'b0: begin
        if (j) begin
          Q <= 1; // if j=1 and k=0, Q is set to 1
        end
      end
      1'b1: begin
        Q = ~Q; // if j and k are both 1, Q toggles
      end
      default: Q <= Q;
    endcase
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input in,
  input reset,
  output done
);

assign clk = clk;
assign reset = reset;
assign in = in;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
  if (reset) begin
    done <= 1'b0
  end else begin
    
    assign temp = done & temp & in

    assign S_temp = in & done
    
    if (in) begin
      if (S_temp)
        done <= 1'b1
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  [3:0] in,
  output [3:0] out_both,
  output [3:0] out_any,
  output [3:0] out_different
);

// Multiplexer for input selection on similar峦
wire [3:0] mux_out;
assign mux_out = in[0] ? in[3:0] : in[0];

// Output assignments based on the logic gates
assign out_both[0] = (mux_out & in[0]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[0]
assign out_both[1] = (mux_out & in[1]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[1]
assign out_both[2] = (mux_out & in[2]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[2]
assign out_both[3] = (mux_out & in[3]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[3]

assign out_any[0] = ( mux_out & in[0]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[0]
assign out_any[1] = (mux_out & in[1]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[1]
assign out_any[2] = ( mux_out & in[2]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[2]
assign out_any[3] = ( mux_out & in[3]); // AND gate with multiplexer output and input[3]

assign out_different[0] = (mux_out ^ in[0]); // XOR gate with multiplexer output and input[0]
assign out_different[1] = (mux_out ^ in[1]); // XOR gate with multiplexer output and input[1]
assign out_different[2] = (mux_out ^ in[2]); // XOR gate with multiplexer output and input[2]
assign out_different[3] = ( mux_out ^ in[3]); // XOR gate with multiplexer output and input[3]

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input bump_left,
  input bump_right,
  output walk_left,
  output walk_right
);

  reg state; // Corresponds to Q output

  always begin
    if (areset) begin
      state >= 0;
    end else begin
      if (bump_left) begin
        state <= 1;
      end else if (bump_right) begin
        state <= 0;
      end else begin
        state <= state;
      end
    end
  end

  assign walk_left = ~state; // Inverted output for walk_left
  assign walk_right = state; // Direct output for walk_right

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input d,
  input done_counting,
  input ack,
  input [9:0] state, // 10-bit one-hot current state
  output B3_next,
  output S_next,
  output S1_next,
  output Count_next,
  output Wait_next,
  output done,
  output counting,
  output shift_ena
);

assign counting = state[8]; // Counting when state[8] is 1

assign B3_next = (state[4] & state[5]) | (state[1] & state[5]); // from the logic

assign S_next = (state[9] & done_counting) | (state[1] & d); // from the logic

assign S1_next = (state[1] & state[4]) & (~state[5]); // OR gate with NOT gate for ~state[5]

assign count_next = state[8] | (state[9] & ~ack); // from the OR gate (ORed with inverted ack)

assign wait_next = state[9] | (state[1] & state[9]); // OR gate from state[9] and state[1], state[9]

assign done = state[6]; // from the output connector

assign shift_ena = (state[2] & state[6]) | (state[1] & state[6]); // OR gate from state[2], state[6] and state[1], state[6]

endmodule

end
